topic: Tool Call Batching Discipline for Parallel Execution
evidence: Claude Code executes independent tool calls in parallel. Batching rules: all file reads that do not depend on each other go in one response turn. All file writes/edits that do not conflict go in one response turn. Script executions that are independent can be issued as parallel Bash calls. Do not chain Read->Edit->Read when second Read is only to confirm (Edit succeeds or errors). What cannot be parallel: write that depends on content of prior read in same turn; script whose input is output of another script in same turn; receipt writes (each phase's receipt depends on prior phase's receipt). Applies to framework authoring and product-space tasks equally. Batching is the primary mechanism for seed run speed improvement.
